errors.offline: You're offline. Showing what we last loaded.

codes.otp_attempts_exceeded: Too many incorrect codes. Request a new one.

welcome.title: Your rent, sorted
welcome.subtitle: See what you owe, pay your landlord safely and keep every receipt in one place.

auth.signUpSubtitle: Use the phone number your landlord has for you. We'll text you a code.
auth.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid Nigerian phone number.
auth.acceptTerms: I agree to the Homesika Terms and Privacy Policy
auth.signInSubtitle: Sign in on this phone with your phone number and 6-digit PIN.
auth.noAccount: New to Homesika? Create an account
auth.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in

otp.title: Enter the code
otp.sentSms: We sent a 6-digit code by SMS to {{destination}}.
otp.useEmail: Send it to my email instead

pin.createSubtitle: 6 digits you'll use to open Homesika. Don't use your birthday.
pin.mismatch: The PINs didn't match. Try again.
pin.weak: Choose a less predictable PIN (not 123456 or 111111).
pin.forgotSubtitle: Enter your phone number. We'll send a code so you can set a new PIN. Other phones will be signed out.

lock.title: Welcome back
lock.switchBody: This phone will be unlinked. You'll need your phone number, PIN and a code to sign in again.
lock.offerBioBody: Use your fingerprint or face instead of typing your PIN.

home.allPaidBody: No unpaid charges right now. We'll show new ones here.
home.notLinkedBody: Ask your landlord to add your number {{phone}} on Homesika. Your rent and charges will appear here once they do.

charges.title: Charges
charges.oneLandlord: You can pay one landlord at a time. We've switched your selection to {{landlord}}.
charges.emptyBody: When your landlord adds rent or other charges, they'll show here.

pay.checkingBody: This usually takes a few seconds.
pay.successBody: Thank you. Your landlord has been paid.
pay.processingBody: We haven't got confirmation from the bank yet. If you were debited, it will show here automatically. Don't pay again.
pay.notPaidBody: This payment link has {{status}}. You were not charged. You can start again from Charges.

payments.title: Payments
payments.emptyBody: Payments you make, and ones your landlord records, will show here with receipts.
payments.receiptFailed: We couldn't get the receipt. Try again.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Name
profile.languageHint: Choose the language for the app
profile.signOutBody: You'll need your phone number, PIN and a code to sign in again.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp messages
whatsapp.body: Get your rent reminders and receipts on WhatsApp instead of SMS.
whatsapp.toggle: Send reminders and receipts on WhatsApp
whatsapp.stop: Reply STOP on WhatsApp at any time to turn them off.

help.title: Help
help.emptyBody: Ask about your rent, payments, receipts or lease. You can write in English or Pidgin.
help.emergency: In an emergency call 112. Homesika is not an emergency service.

suggestions.nextDue: When is my next rent due?

help.notSent: Not sent. Tap to try again
help.escalated: We've passed this to a person. They'll reply here in this chat during working hours (Lagos time).
help.clearBody: This deletes your chat history with the Homesika assistant. It can't be undone.

find.title: Find a place
find.emptyBody: Try another area, a higher rent or any number of bedrooms.
find.noSlots: No viewing times are open right now. Ask about it and the landlord can get back to you.
find.name: Your name
find.asked: Sent. The landlord can now reach you on {{phone}}.

bills.title: Pay bills
bills.homeBody: Airtime, data, TV and electricity. Pay for each purchase, no wallet needed.
bills.howItWorks: You pay for each purchase at checkout. There's no wallet or balance to top up. If we can't deliver it, we refund you automatically.
bills.choose: What do you want to pay for?

categoryHint.cable_tv: Pay for DStv, GOtv, Startimes and more
categoryHint.electricity: Buy a prepaid token or pay a postpaid bill

bills.phoneHint: We've filled in your number. Change it to buy for someone else.
bills.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid Nigerian phone number.
bills.customerInvalid: Check the number and try again.
bills.meterFromHome: Your meter at {{unit}}. Change it to pay for a different meter.
bills.discoUnknown: We couldn't tell which electricity company your home uses. Please choose it.
bills.noPlans: No plans are available right now. Please try again later.

amountErrors.invalid: Enter an amount in naira, like 1500.
amountErrors.whole: Enter a whole naira amount (no kobo).

bills.noBillersBody: This service isn't available at the moment. Please try again later.

review.title: Check and pay
review.name: Name
review.feeAdded: A service fee of {{fee}} applies, so you'll pay {{total}} in total.

bills.historyEmptyBody: Airtime, data, TV and electricity you buy will show here.

order.checkingBody: This usually takes a few seconds.
order.checkFailed: We couldn't check the status. Check your connection and try again.
order.awaitingBody: Finish paying in the checkout. If you've already paid, this page will update by itself.
order.processingBody: We've got your payment and we're sending it now. This usually takes under a minute. If it can't be delivered, we'll refund you automatically. Don't pay again.
order.tokenHint: Type this token into your meter. We've also sent it to you by SMS.
order.copyFailed: We couldn't copy it. Press and hold the token to copy it.
order.receiptFailed: We couldn't get the receipt. Try again.
order.refundPendingBody: We're refunding {{amount}} to the card or account you paid with. It usually arrives in 1–5 working days.
order.refundedBody: We couldn't deliver this, so we refunded {{amount}} to the card or account you paid with. Refunds usually arrive in 1–5 working days, depending on your bank.
order.expiredBody: This payment wasn't completed, so you weren't charged. You can start a new one.

errors.customer_not_found: We couldn't find that meter or smartcard number. Check it and try again.
errors.bills_daily_limit: You've reached today's limit for bill payments. Try again tomorrow.
errors.bills_unavailable: Bill payments are temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
errors.order_not_payable: This order can no longer be paid. Please start a new one.
